You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    C=comps_of(g)
    byc={}
    for c,comp in C: byc.setdefault(c,[]).append(comp)
    res=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    bands=[]
    for c,comps in byc.items():
        lo,hi=sorted(comps,key=len)
        big,sm=hi,lo
        # big flush bottom; small with 1-row gap above; small left-aligned to big
        bh=max(i for i,_ in big)-min(i for i,_ in big)+1
        st=h-1-bh-2
        bg=min(j for _,j in big)
        for (comp,rt),cell in ((big,h-1),(sm,st)):
            pass
        bigt=h-1
        bst=bigt-2-smmax
        smh=max(i for i,_ in sm)-min(i for i,_ in sm)+1
        bst=bigt-2-smh+1
        for comp,rt in ((big,bigt),(sm,bst)):
            for di,dj in rel(comp):
                res[rt+di][bg+dj]=c
        bands.append((bg,max(max(j for _,j in rel(p))+1 for p in comps)))
    # order bands by min fragment size ascending
    bands.sort(key=lambda b:min(min(i for i,_ in rel(p)) for p in byc[b]))
    # rebuild: order colors by min frag height? use min frag size
    order=sorted(byc.keys(),key=lambda c:min(len(p) for p in byc[c]))
    prev=None
    for c in order:
        comps=sorted(byc[c],key=len)
        lo,hi=comps
        big,sm=hi,lo
        bh=max(i for i,_ in big)-min(i for i,_ in big)+1
        bh2=max(max(i for i,_ in big)-min(i for i,_ in big)+1,1)
        smh=max(i for i,_ in sm)-min(i for i,_ in sm)+1
        st=h-1-bh-2
        bst=h-1-bh-2-smh+1
        bg=0 if prev is None else prev[0]+2*(prev[1])+1-prev[0]-prev[1]-1-1  # placeholder
        prev=None
        break
    return res

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    C=comps_of(g)
    byc={}
    for c,comp in C: byc.setdefault(c,[]).append(comp)
    order=sorted(byc.keys(),key=lambda c:(min(len(p) for p in byc[c]),sum(len(p) for p in byc[c])))
    res=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    prev=None
    for c in order:
        lo,hi=sorted(byc[c],key=len)
        bigh,smh=max(i for i,_ in hi)-min(i for i,_ in hi)+1, max(i for i,_ in lo)-min(i for i,_ in lo)+1
        bot=min(j for _,j in hi)
        tl=h-1-bigh-1-smh+1   # top frag bottom row = bottom_top - 2
        bl=prev[0]+prev[1]+1 if prev else 0
        for comp,rt in ((hi,h-1),(lo,tl)):
            r0=min(i for i,_ in comp); c0=min(j for _,j in comp)
            for i,j in comp: res[rt+(i-r0)][bl+(j-c0)]=c
        prev=(bl,max(max(j for _,j in rel(p))+1 for p in byc[c]))
    return res

import numpy as np,collections
def f(ci):
    g=np.array(ci); H,W=g.shape
    comps=comps4(g)
    # group by color
    groups=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for c,pnts in comps: groups[c].append(pnts)
    # order colors by latest first appearance in scan order
    order=[color for color,_ in sorted(groups.items(),
        key=lambda kv: -[i for i,(y,x) in enumerate([p for p in []])])][::-1] if False else None
    # correct: latest appearance = max index in scan order of any cell of that color
    first_rows={}
    for i,row in enumerate(g):
        cols=set(row)
        for c in cols:
            if c!=0: first_rows.setdefault(c,i)
    colorder=sorted(groups, key=lambda c:-first_rows[c])
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    prev_maxw=0
    for c in colorder:
        P=groups[c]
        # sort by (size, height) asc
        P.sort(key=lambda pts:(len(pts),max(y for y,x in pts)-min(y for y,x in pts)))
        # strip column
        Col=prev_maxw+2
        # stack bottom-aligned with 1-row gaps
        total_h=sum(max(y for y,x in pts)-min(y for y,x in pts)+1 for pts in P)
        start_row=H-1-(total_h+len(P)-1)
        for k,pts in enumerate(P):
            h=max(y for y,x in pts)-min(y for y,x in pts)+1
            top=start_row+k*h+(k>0)  # gap between comps? gaps only between consecutive
            # easier: place from bottom up
            pass
        for k,pts in enumerate(reversed(P)):
            # bottom-aligned: this comp bottom at H-1-(h_of_lower_comps)*? just do iterative from bottom
            pass
        # simpler: build list of (height) then place from bottom
        hs=[max(y for y,x in pts)-min(y for y,x in pts)+1 for pts in P]
        pos=H-1
        for h in reversed(hs):
            top=pos-h+1
            for yy,xx in pts:
                oy=yy-min(y for y,x in pts); ox=xx-min(x for y,x in pts)
                yy2=top+oy; xx2=Col+ox
                out[yy2][xx2]=c
            pos=top-2
        prev_maxw=max(prev_maxw, max(x for y,x in groups[colorder[0]][0]) if False else 0)
        prev_maxw+=max(max(x for y,x in pts) for pts in P)-min(x for y,x in P[0])+1
    return out
ok=True
for p in [1,2,3,4]:
    ci=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; co=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {p} output'])
    o=np.array(f(ci))
    m=(o==co).all()
    print(p,'match' if m else 'MISMATCH')
    ok&=m
print('ALL',ok)

import numpy as np,collections
def comps4(g):
    g=np.array(g); H,W=g.shape; seen=np.zeros((H,W),bool); out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i,j] and not seen[i,j]:
                col=int(g[i,j]); q=collections.deque([(i,j)]); seen[i,j]=True; pts=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); pts.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=yy<H and 0<=xx<W and g[yy,xx]==col and not seen[yy,xx]:
                            seen[yy,xx]=True; q.append((yy,xx))
                out.append((col,frozenset(pts)))
    return out

def f(ci):
    g=np.array(ci); H,W=g.shape
    comps=comps4(g)
    # color order: first appearance in scan order
    first=[None]*11
    for i,row in enumerate(g):
        for x,v in enumerate(row):
            if v: first[v]=i
    colorder=sorted(collections.defaultdict(list), key=lambda c:first[c])
    # comps keyed by color, sorted within color by (perimeter,bbox, size)
    groups=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for c,pnts in comps: groups[c].append(pnts)
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    curx=0
    for c in colorder:
        Ps=groups[c]
        Ps.sort(key=lambda pts:(2*(max(y for y,x in pts)-min(y for y,x in pts)+1+max(x for y,x in pts)-min(x for y,x in pts))+0, len(pts), max(y for y,x in pts)-min(y for y,x in pts)))
        # careful: perimeter = 2*(h+w) where h,w are bbox dims
        Ps.sort(key=lambda pts:(2*((max(y for y,x in pts)-min(y for y,x in pts)+1)+(max(x for y,x in pts)-min(x for y,x in pts)+1)), len(pts)))
        maxw=max(max(x for y,x in pts) for pts in Ps)
        pos=H-1
        for k,pts in enumerate(reversed(Ps)):
            h=max(y for y,x in pts)-min(y for y,x in pts)+1
            top=pos-h+1
            for oy,ox in [(y-min(y for yy,xx in pts),x-min(xx for yy,xx in pts)) for y,x in pts]:
                pass
            ty=top
            for yy,xx in pts:
                out[ty+(yy-min(y for a,b in pts))][curx+(xx-min(x for a,b in pts))]=c
            pos=top-2
        curx+=maxw+1
    return out

import numpy as np,collections,json
def comps4(g):
    g=np.array(g); H,W=g.shape; seen=np.zeros((H,W),bool); out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i,j] and not seen[i,j]:
                col=int(g[i,j]); q=collections.deque([(i,j)]); seen[i,j]=True; pts=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); pts.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=yy<H and 0<=xx<W and g[yy,xx]==col and not seen[yy,xx]:
                            seen[yy,xx]=True; q.append((yy,xx))
                out.append((col,frozenset(pts)))
    return out

def f(ci):
    g=np.array(ci); H=len(ci); W=len(ci[0])
    comps=comps4(g)
    groups=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for c,pnts in comps: groups[c].append(pnts)
    # color order: band whose largest comp appears lowest goes last -> sort by max comp top-row asc
    colorder=sorted(groups,key=lambda c:max(min(y for y,x in pnts) for pnts in groups[c]))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    curx=0
    for c in colorder:
        Ps=groups[c]
        Ps.sort(key=lambda pts:(-(max(y for y,x in pts)-min(y for y,x in pts)), -len(pts)))
        bw=max(max(x for y,x in pts)-min(x for y,x in pts)+1 for pts in Ps)
        lev=H-1
        for pts in Ps:
            ys=[y for y,x in pts]; xs=[x for y,x in pts]
            h=max(ys)-min(ys)+1; top=lev-h+1
            for yy,xx in pts:
                oy,ox=yy-min(ys),xx-min(xs)
                out[top+oy][curx+ox]=c
            lev=top-2
        curx+=bw+1
    return out

allok=True
for p in [1,2,3,4]:
    ci=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; co=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {p} output'])
    o=np.array(f(ci)); m=(o==co).all()
    allok&=m
    print(p,'match' if m else 'MISMATCH')
print('ALL',allok)

import numpy as np,collections,json
def comps4(g):
    g=np.array(g); H,W=g.shape; seen=np.zeros((H,W),bool); out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i,j] and not seen[i,j]:
                col=int(g[i,j]); q=collections.deque([(i,j)]); seen[i,j]=True; pts=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); pts.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=yy<H and 0<=xx<W and g[yy,xx]==col and not seen[yy,xx]:
                            seen[yy,xx]=True; q.append((yy,xx))
                out.append((col,frozenset(pts)))
    return out

def f(ci):
    g=np.array(ci); H=len(ci); W=len(ci[0])
    comps=comps4(g)
    groups=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for c,pnts in comps: groups[c].append(pnts)
    # band order: color whose leftmost component appears earliest in scan order
    colorder=sorted(groups,key=lambda c:min(min(x for y,x in pnts) for pnts in groups[c]))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    curx=0
    for c in colorder:
        Ps=groups[c]
        Ps.sort(key=lambda pts:(max(y for y,x in pts)-min(y for y,x in pts), len(pts)))
        bw=max(max(x for y,x in pts)-min(x for y,x in pts)+1 for pts in Ps)
        lev=H-1
        for pts in reversed(Ps):
            ys=[y for y,x in pts]; xs=[x for y,x in pts]
            h=max(ys)-min(ys)+1; top=lev-h+1
            for yy,xx in pts:
                oy,ox=yy-min(ys),xx-min(xs)
                out[top+oy][curx+ox]=c
            lev=top-2
        curx+=bw+1
    return out

for p in [1,2,3,4]:
    ci=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; co=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {p} output'])
    o=np.array(f(ci)); m=(o==co).all()
    print(p,'match' if m else 'MISMATCH')
res=f(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(res))

def f(ci):
    g=np.array(ci); H=len(ci); Wg=len(ci[0])
    sg=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for c,ps in comps_of(g): sg[c].append(ps)
    # unit order: total pixels desc
    units=sorted(sg,key=lambda c:-sum(len(q) for q in sg[c]))
    out=[[0]*Wg for _ in range(H)]
    cur=0
    for c in units:
        Ps=sorted(sg[c],key=lambda q:(min(xx for _,xx in q),len(q),min(yy for yy,_ in q)))
        # place bottom-up with 1-row gaps, left at cur
        tot_h=sum(max(yy for yy,_ in q)-min(yy for yy,_ in q)+1 for q in Ps)+(len(Ps)-1)
        top=H-tot_h
        col=None
        for q in Ps:
            ys=[y for y,_ in q]; hs=max(ys)-min(ys)+1
            tt=top-(hs-1)-((len(Ps)-Ps.index(q))-1)  # provisional
        # simpler: iterate from bottom
        lev=H-1
        placed=[]
        for q in reversed(Ps):
            hs=max(yy for yy,_ in q)-min(yy for yy,_ in q)+1
            tt=lev-hs+1
            placed.append((tt,q))
            lev=tt-2
        for tt,q in placed:
            mx=min(xx for _,xx in q); my=min(yy for yy,_ in q)
            ok=False
            for yy,xx in q:
                oy,ox=yy-my,xx-mx
                if out[tt+oy][cur+ox]==0: ok=True; break
            while not ok and cur+Wg>0:
                cur+=1
                ok=True
                for yy,xx in q:
                    oy,ox=yy-my,xx-mx
                    if out[tt+oy][cur+ox]!=0: ok=False; break
                if not ok: break
            if ok:
                for yy,xx in q:
                    out[tt+yy-my][cur+xx-mx]=c
        cur+=1  # 1-col gap after unit
    return out

def f(ci):
    g=np.array(ci); H,W=g.shape
    comps=comps_of(g)
    sg=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for c,ps in comps: sg[c].append(ps)
    # unit order: total pixels desc
    units=sorted(sg,key=lambda c:-sum(len(q) for q in sg[c]))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]; cur=0
    for c in units:
        Ps=sorted(sg[c],key=len,reverse=True)   # larger comps lower
        lev=H-1
        for q in Ps:
            hs=max(yy for yy,_ in q)-min(yy for yy,_ in q)+1
            tt=lev-hs+1
            my=min(yy for yy,_ in q); mx=min(xx for _,xx in q)
            for yy,xx in q:
                out[tt+yy-my][cur+xx-mx]=c
            lev=tt-2
        cur+=max(max(xx for _,xx in q) for q in [Ps[-1]])+1  # placeholder
    return out
for p in [1,2,3,4]:
    ci=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; co=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {p} output'])
    o=np.array(f(ci))
    print(p,'match',(o==co).all())

import os,re,collections,numpy as np,json,itertools
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

import numpy as np, collections, json

def comps_of(g):
    g=np.array(g); H,W=g.shape; seen=np.zeros((H,W),bool); out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i,j]!=0 and not seen[i,j]:
                col=int(g[i,j]); q=collections.deque([(i,j)]); seen[i,j]=True; pts=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); pts.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=yy<H and 0<=xx<W and g[yy,xx]==col and not seen[yy,xx]:
                            seen[yy,xx]=True; q.append((yy,xx))
                out.append((col,frozenset(pts)))
    return out

def f(ci):
    g=np.array(ci); H,W=g.shape
    comps=comps_of(g)
    bycolor=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for c,ps in comps: bycolor[c].append(ps)
    # band order: reverse reading order of each color's last comp
    def last(pss): return max(max(p) for p in pss)  # (y,x) max
    orders=sorted(bycolor,key=lambda c:-last(bycolor[c]))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    left=0
    for c in orders:
        Ps=sorted([list(p_) for p_ in bycolor[c]],key=lambda p:(-len(p), -max(y for y,_ in p), -min(x for _,x in p)))
        band_w=max(max(x for _,x in p) for p in Ps)+1
        cur=H-1
        for P in Ps:
            ht=max(y for y,_ in P)-min(y for y,_ in P)+1
            tt=cur-ht+1
            for (yy,xx) in P:
                out[tt+yy-min(y for y,_ in P)][left+xx-min(x for _,x in P)]=c
            if len(Ps.index(P))<len(Ps)-1:
                # gap unless next comp same size
                nxt=Ps[len(Ps.index(P))+1]
                if len(nxt)!=len(P): cur-=1
            cur=tt-1
        left+=band_w+1
    return out

allok=True
for p in [1,2,3,4]:
    pred=f(G[f'Demo pair {p} input']); exp=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    m=np.array_equal(np.array(pred),np.array(exp))
    allok&=m
    print(p,'match:',m)

    res=json.dumps(f(G['Test input']))

import numpy as np, collections, os, re

def cc(g):
    g=np.array(g); H,W=g.shape; seen=np.zeros((H,W),bool); out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i,j]!=0 and not seen[i,j]:
                col=int(g[i,j]); q=collections.deque([(i,j)]); seen[i,j]=True; pts=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); pts.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=yy<H and 0<=xx<W and g[yy,xx]==col and not seen[yy,xx]:
                            seen[yy,xx]=True; q.append((yy,xx))
                out.append((col,frozenset(pts)))
    return out

    ys=[y for y,_ in q]; xs=[x for _,x in q]
    sub=np.zeros((max(ys)-min(ys)+1,max(xs)-min(xs)+1),dtype=int)
    for y,x in q: sub[y-min(ys),x-min(xs)]=1
    print(sub.astype(str).replace('0','.'))
print()

print(sorted(e))

import numpy as np, collections
def cc(g):
    g=np.array(g); H,W=g.shape; seen=np.zeros((H,W),bool); out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i,j]!=0 and not seen[i,j]:
                col=int(g[i,j]); q=collections.deque([(i,j)]); seen[i,j]=True; pts=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); pts.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=yy<H and 0<=xx<W and g[yy,xx]==col and not seen[yy,xx]:
                            seen[yy,xx]=True; q.append((yy,xx))
                out.append((int(col),tuple(sorted(pts))))
    return out

                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); pts.append((y,x))

def solve(gin):
    g=np.array(gin); H,W=g.shape
    comps=comps_of(gin)
    # group by color, order by max bottom row ascending (shallowest first)
    groups=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for c,p in comps: groups[c].append(p)
    order=sorted(groups,key=lambda c:max(max(y for y,_ in p) for p in groups[c]))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]; placed=set()
    for c in order:
        pcs=groups[c]
        pcs.sort(key=len)  # smaller on top
        # internal stack: bottom piece bottom-aligned at H-1, 1-row gaps; each piece keeps shape, left-aligned to bottom piece min col
        botp=max(pcs,key=lambda p:max(y for y,_ in p))
        botmax=max(y for y,_ in botp); bmin=min(x for _,x in botp)
        # vertical offsets from bottom: piece at rank i from top -> bottom - sum of heights above - 1*i... compute per piece
        tops=[]
        rem=H-botmax-1  # free rows above bottom piece top
        for i,p in enumerate(pcs):
            tops.append(rem-i)
        for (p,t) in zip(pcs,tops):
            for y,x in p:
                cy,cc=t+y,bmin+x
                if cc<0 or cc+W>W or cy<0 or cy>H or (cy,cc) in placed: return None
                ok=False
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    if 0<=cy+dy<H and 0<=cc+dx<W and (cy+dy,cc+dx) in placed: ok=True
                if not ok:

                        if 0<=cy+ddy<H and 0<=cc+ddx<W and (cy+ddy,cc+ddx) in placed: ok=True
                if ok: return None
            for y,x in p:
                out[t+y][bmin+x]=c; placed.add((t+y,bmin+x))
    return out

def f(gin):
    g=[r[:] for r in gin]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cc=comps8(g)
    groups=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for col,p in cc: groups[col].append(p)
    bands=[]
    for col,pcs in groups.items():
        s=sorted(pcs,key=lambda p:len(p))           # smallest on top
        bws=max(max(x for _,x in p)-min(x for _,x in p)+1 for p in s)
        bands.append((col,s,bws,min(x for _,x in p for p in s)))
    bands.sort(key=lambda b:(-b[2],b[3]))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]; cur=0
    for col,s,bw,mc in bands:
        rem=H-1
        for p in reversed(s):                        # bottom-up
            h=max(y for y,_ in p)-min(y for y,_ in p)+1
            t=rem-h+1
            for y,x in p: out[t+y-min(y for y,_ in p)][cur+x-mc]=col
